clubParas: This is the LGW02 with the volume turned down. Same forged body, same grind, same behavior out of the same lies. The only thing that changed is what it looks like at address.

Blacked-out finish with gold on the clover and the loft stamp, and nothing else. At address it disappears against the grass, which some golfers find easier to aim and others find they miss the gold entirely.
It is the full six-loft lineup, unlike the gold V2, which stops at three.
Right hand today. Left hand is on the way, so if that is what you need it is worth waiting rather than settling for the gold.

specTabs.aside: Both grinds are the same forged 1020 head at 300 g. Where they differ is the sole, and the bounce and lie that come with it. The S measures more bounce than the K at the same loft and plays less of it, because the narrower sole puts less of itself on the turf.

This is that club. It still has gold on it, on the clover and the number, but you have to be standing over it to find any.

helpLoft.headline: Start with the wedge you already carry
helpLoft.sub: Wedges work in gaps. Four to six degrees between clubs keeps your distances even and stops two wedges going the same yardage. The Black comes in all six lofts, so a full ladder is available in this finish.

_01: THE 01, BLACK. Same club as the gold on the LGW01 platform (v1.8's platform note), K grind, six lofts. $109 rather than $99 because the blacked-out finish is a real extra process — the one price difference in the wedge line that stands for something (Cole 2026-07-31).

GRIND COPY — sourced, no longer a draft.
1. SOURCE IS THE SPEC-TO-BENEFIT TRANSLATION GUIDE v1.0 (Cole supplied it 2026-08-01, references-spec-to-benefit-v1.0.md). It defines both grinds directly: K is "a wider, flatter sole profile with a standard leading edge... the no-surprises wedge... built for the golfer who strikes cleanly and plays primarily from standard lies"; S is "a narrower, more relieved sole with a reshaped leading edge... the versatility wedge... tight lies, awkward angles, open-face lobs".
2. THIS REVERSES AN EARLIER CORRECTION. HANDOFF §24d recorded that the S is NOT the open-face versatility grind, on the basis that our letters are Vokey's and that is Vokey's M. Lucky's own written guide says otherwise, and a company document about what Lucky's specs mean outranks an inference from another maker's nomenclature. The site now follows the guide. If Cole wants the Vokey reading back, this is the block to change.
3. IT ALSO CLOSES §24a's open question. "Is our S actually narrower, does it have a tapered rear sole" is answered in writing: narrower, more relieved, reshaped leading edge. This block is no longer the unverified one.
4. Every number in `facts` is still the manufacturer sheet, and the measured-vs-effective bounce note still stands — a narrow relieved sole carrying more measured bounce than a wide flat one is exactly what the geometry predicts.

grinds.headline: One sole, and it is the steady one.
grinds.sub: Grind is the shape of the sole, the part of the club that meets the turf. The Black is built on the K grind, the wider sole. If you want the S, the narrower one that opens up, it is on the Gold.

options.name: The no-surprises one
options.forWho: Standard lies, and a square setup
paras: K grind is the wider, flatter sole, with a standard leading edge. Spreading turf contact over more of the sole is what stops the club digging, so it bottoms out in the same place shot after shot: set up square, swing through, take your divot, and it does what you expect.

That makes it the one for standard lies: fairway, rough, fringe, full swings and the straightforward short-game shots. The bounce steps with the loft rather than sitting flat: 8° on the 50 and the 52, where you are hitting full shots and do not want the sole in the way; 12° on the 54 and the 56, which are the ones you take into a bunker; 10° on the 58 and the 60.

facts.v: Wider and flatter, standard leading edge

grinds.short: Short version: K for standard lies and a square setup. The S grind, for tight lies and an open face, is on the 01 Gold.
